declarations.name: AuiEmptyState

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Short statement of the state, such as 'No employees match your filters'.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: What to do next or why the area is empty (text).

inputs.name: illustration
inputs.description: Decorative illustration (image or SVG Node) instead of the icon.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading level of the title, or null for plain text (inside tables and lists).

inputs.name: live
inputs.description: Announce the empty state when it appears (role=status).

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: sm inside tables and lists, md in panels, lg for whole pages.

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: The user activated an action: { action: 'primary' | 'secondary' }.

accessibility.pattern: Static content: a heading (or paragraph) with description and native buttons or links; optionally a polite status region so its appearance is announced.

limitations: The icon and illustration are decorative; put meaning in the title and description.
